title: Review ask after five confirmed translations
reason: Translation is a frequent tool, so use five completed unique backend jobs rather than the generic three-action default. The shared background submitJob and translation:get paths cover popup, selection, and page batches, including already-completed idempotent POST retries; deduplicate by job.id to prevent polling from increasing the count. A single large page can contain several jobs, so this threshold measures completed batches rather than five distinct browsing sessions.
placement: A compact line at the bottom of the popup on the next idle view, after a confirmed result. Suppress during authentication, translation, page progress, pauses/errors, or sign-out. Do not place it over results.
integrationPoints: extension/src/background.ts: submitJob after rememberJob(job), before return job
extension/src/background.ts: handle translation:get after ownJob/API/rememberJob, before return job
extension/src/background.ts: requireUi(sender) for proposed review:rate and review:dismiss handlers
extension/src/ui/main.tsx: idle popup footer; keep exactly 420px width
extension/src/shared/protocol.ts: RuntimeRequest proposals; meta/locales/en/messages.json review strings
policy: Request an honest review with no reward, satisfaction pre-question, five-star request, or gating. Rate opens this extension's runtime-ID review URL then marks done permanently. First dismissal delays 14 days; second dismissal stops future asks. Store links may 404 until the existing draft is public. All behavior is a proposal, not currently present in the package.

title: Welcome page on first install
reason: A toolbar popup has a real first-use path: pin, Google sign-in, choose languages and translate text. Existing onInstalled only creates menus; there is no packaged welcome page. Recommend a small local welcome page on first install only, using the new character limits and explicitly marking page translation as Pro.
integrationPoints: extension/src/background.ts: replace existing onInstalled listener, preserve createMenus
extension/vite.config.ts: add welcome.html to existing multi-page build inputs
new packaged welcome.html and src/welcome.ts; use existing local styles and original artwork
constraints: Open once on INSTALL only, never update or reload. No remote scripts/fonts/tracking, automatic translation, uninstall URL, or new permission. English only until translated drafts are actually created and packaged.

title: Enable manifest locale messages before localized listings
reason: Built manifest name and description are literal English strings, default_locale is absent, and dist has no _locales. The app's separate Ukrainian/English UI does not provide Chrome Web Store listing locales.
integrationPoints: extension/scripts/build.mjs: source manifest generation, not generated dist
meta/locales/en/messages.json: recommended name option0 and short-description option1
extension/src/ui/i18n.ts and extension/src/content/ui.ts: existing independent UI dictionaries
constraints: Normal marketing run creates only the English catalog draft. Translate mode was not requested; no other locale catalogs or descriptions were written. After source implementation, rerun locale-audit.mjs against extension/dist. Adding the overlay alone is not an installable package.

title: Review activeTab overlap before submission
reason: The code uses current-tab selection capture, but persistent wildcard HTTP(S) access already grants regular website access. activeTab may be redundant in this package. It must not be described as the reason broad site access is necessary.
integrationPoints: extension/dist/manifest.json: activeTab plus wildcard HTTP(S) host permissions
constraints: No manifest changes made. If removed in a separate engineering task, verify popup selection capture, existing-tab injection, frame translation, and protected-page errors. A switch to optional site access would change the automatic selection-icon behavior.
